scope: Native Files toolbar/row presentation and canonical colored file icons; actual file/directory creation with Enter. Android, installed clients, daemon and real sessions unchanged.

linuxGUI.keyboardRegression: Before the input row tracked its own focus handle, typing succeeded but Return never reached its handler and no file was created. The final OS-input run creates both entries with Return.

iconAssets.rasterCache: Per icon name at current device pixel size; previous scale set is dropped. No file-by-file raster duplication.

producers.instructions: Use a fresh isolated daemon/home/display :99 and private dark/English config. Select the retained terminal workspace and open Files at320px before gui-qa. Reference is a real Electron renderer against the same fixture and unmodified header-checkpoint app export. Capture parity BEFORE gui-qa mutates the private filesystem. GUI scripts are copied into the QA directory, using its fixture.json.

limitations: NOT_PASSED: font rasterization, tab sizing/corners, launcher and other pixel differences remain. The extra prototype filename-search button accounts for a known toolbar difference until Command Center migration.
File selector matching does not prove rasterization of all54 icons or OS/DPI display changes. Only the captured file types were rendered in this QA.

Sort and hidden-file preferences are not persisted across native client restart. Complete Files selection/context menus, creation form presentation, search/command center, panel host and drag/drop still need acceptance.
OCR validates mode labels, hidden toggle and search result plus four known file orders. input.jsonl is misrecognized and excluded from order assertions; see raw observations.
macOS/Windows evidence is source-verified compilation/core tests, not native GUI interaction or performance. No hardware CPU/RSS/latency, packaging or deployment acceptance.
logNormalization: Stored logs normalize CRLF/trailing whitespace and final newline.
